name: apple-use
description: Codex-local EventKit Reminders tools and routing to supported Apple app connectors.

interface.shortDescription: EventKit Reminders and supported Apple app workflows
interface.longDescription: Provides local EventKit-backed Reminders tools and environment checks. Routes Calendar, Notes and other Apple app requests to supported public interfaces; email uses the standalone apple-mail workflow.
defaultPrompt: Check EventKit Reminders authorization and local Apple toolchain status
